risks: No participants. The ethical risk is a committee decision that extends technicians' roles beyond their regulated scope or competence on the strength of an incomplete map.
consent: Not applicable; no human participants or personal data.
data: Only published and publicly available reports; the charting file is shared with the committee.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: charting records rurality, weekend coverage and whether reports considered patients with limited English, low health literacy or many medicines, so the committee can see whether technician roles reach the patients most at risk at discharge.
effectiveness: The review succeeds if it answers the committee's five questions by March with its limits stated.
efficiency: About 80 hours of pharmacist time; library support within existing services.
partnerships: Hospital library, two pharmacy technicians who take histories, a ward pharmacist and a patient partner from the hospital's patient advisory group.
rebPath: No REB review needed: no human participants or identifiable data.
limitations: English only; single reviewer if the resident is not released; grey literature may be incomplete.
summary: No participants; the ethical weight lies in giving the committee an honest map with its limits.
